name: 古钟蛇
habitatEn: Caught with a 4-star shiny flower seed
evolution: 古钟蛇 → 寒音蛇 Lv.38
description: 通常低伏身体，隐藏在草丛中，只露出尾巴发出咚咚咚的轻响，吸引好奇的精灵过来。其尾部的结构可以在摇晃时发出咚咚的鼓声，据说玄玉岛的洛克以此为灵感，制作出了某种广受欢迎的玩具。
descriptionEn: It usually keeps its body low, hidden in the grass, exposing only its tail to make soft thumping sounds that draw curious spirits closer. The structure of its tail can produce drum-like thumps when shaken; it is said that the Lokes of Xuanyu Island took inspiration from this to create a widely popular toy.

skills.name: 溃烂触碰
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 魅惑
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 示弱
skills.description: 自己获得萌化：速度永久+150。

skills.name: 以毒攻毒
skills.description: 敌方每有1层中毒效果，自己获得魔攻+30%。
skills.descriptionEn: For each layer of Poison on the enemy, self gains Magic ATK +30%.

skills.name: 毒孢子
skills.descriptionEn: The enemy gains 5 layers of Poison.

skills.name: 超级糖果
skills.description: 造成物伤，自己获得萌化：本次技能威力+60。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; self gains Cutification: this skill’s power +60.

skills.name: 连续毒针
skills.description: 造成物伤，2连击，每次连击使敌方获得1层中毒。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 2 hits; each hit gives the enemy 1 layer of Poison.

skills.name: 生日蛋糕
skills.description: 驱散自己的减益，自己的增益翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Dispels self debuffs and doubles self buffs.

skills.name: 撒娇
skills.description: 造成魔伤，3连击。自己获得萌化：威力永久+20。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage, 3 hits. Self gains Cutification: power permanently +20.

skills.name: 赤子之心
skills.description: 自己获得萌化：全技能能耗永久-3。
skills.descriptionEn: Self gains Cutification: energy cost of all skills permanently -3.

skills.name: 耍赖
skills.description: 自己获得双攻永久+10%，2连击。自己有减益时，本次技能连击数+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Self gains both ATK stats permanently +10%, 2 hits. When self has debuffs, this skill’s hit count +1.

skills.name: 月光合奏
skills.description: 造成物伤，1连击，双方携带的所有精灵每有1层萌化，本次技能连击数+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 1 hit; for each layer of Cutification on all spirits carried by both sides, this skill’s hit count +1.

skills.name: 剧毒
skills.description: 敌方获得3层中毒，应对防御：改为获得8层。
skills.descriptionEn: The enemy gains 3 layers of Poison; counters defense: changed to 8 layers instead.

skills.name: 毒液渗透
skills.description: 造成魔伤，敌方每有1层中毒效果，本技能能耗-1，敌方获得1层中毒。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; for each layer of Poison on the enemy, this skill’s energy cost -1; the enemy gains 1 layer of Poison.

skills.name: 毒囊
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方获得2层中毒，应对状态：改为获得6层。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the enemy gains 2 layers of Poison; counters status: changed to 6 layers instead.
